text: There’s insufficient evidence to determine tree-cover loss within the asset from 2021–2025. No observations were available from key datasets (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021), leaving the asset’s tree-cover status unassessed. This neither confirms nor rules out deforestation during the period. No compliance findings (e.g., EUDR status) can be drawn. Further data or higher-resolution monitoring is needed for clarity.
